clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Bronzebeard appears in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. His name belongs to the clan that rules the city, and his earthen form recalls the dwarves' stone-born ancestors.

Near the pool in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Elder Bronzebeard appears in the shape of an earthen. The Titans forged the ancient earthen from living stone, before they became creatures of flesh. Dwarven scholars and explorers are only beginning to uncover their origins through excavations across Khaz Modan and beyond. Elder Bronzebeard's name is that of the ruling clan, and his form suggests he is a direct ancestor of the Bronzebeards. His spirit bears witness to how far his stone-born descendants have changed.
